response.rationale: Rapid ascent from saturation dive with microbubbles in right heart and no PFO strongly indicates decompression sickness. Neurological, pulmonary, and musculoskeletal symptoms point to type II DCS. Other diagnoses are less consistent with the diving history and findings.
